name: Scroll Pill Header
summary: A full-width transparent top header that, once a boundary element (the hero) scrolls out of view, hands over to a floating blurred glass pill that drops in from above with a springy ease-out; pill links stay on narrow screens.
useWhen: A landing page with a hero wants a minimal header that becomes a floating pill after the hero
Navigation should reappear compactly without a full sticky bar
avoidWhen: Rich dropdown menus are needed; use marketing/pill-navbar
A persistent full-width sticky bar is wanted; use marketing/product-navbar
